the study of the Mediterranean in the premodern era can no longer be limited to a single approach, be it political, economic, social, or cultural.

, while the notion of diaspora may not be a useful tool for understanding the past, the history of diasporic communities in the Mediterranean can be a useful tool to understand the Mediterranean itself.
